criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: The headline is 9 words of huge Fraunces and reads cleanly at 432 px. The gold hairline over 2030/2027 is a single focal accent. But the cover carries no number and no named tension. 'Reads a year' is statute-insider phrasing, 'SNAP bill' is ambiguous between the law and the invoice, and 'Thursday' goes stale by Tuesday. Nothing in the image says Alaska; only the word does. The band between the headline and the rule (display y about 840 to 1060) is still eventless dark granite. Unchanged from round 2.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: Strong junctions: 01 to 02 (which year, answered by 'Fiscal 2027 is read either way'), 03 to 04 (first share, then second share), 08 to 09 (the dashed FISCAL 2026 bracket, then the uncut field and 'save this'). Weak junctions: Alaska's first number still arrives only on 05, and 04 has no Alaska mark, so the flow critic's predicted bail at 04 stands. 05 to 06 and 06 to 07 are carried by pacing rather than a planted question. 'Thursday' is restated on 01 and 03, and the 2029/2030 delay on 01, 02 and 05.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: Round 3 moved the needle only slightly. Strong frames: 06 (a convincing bas-relief nameplate with brushed grain, domed rivets, a rivet row and a cast onto hammertone), 03 (a white-line engraved dial with knockout numerals and a gold tip), 07 (an exact 332-slot T-card board with lips, throats and manila cards). Improved: 02's 2024/2025 fields now read as milled steel pockets instead of barcodes, and 08's tags are now manila with soft shadows. Still short: 04, the declared masterful depth frame, remains a 2.5D step chart. Zero yaw means no riser side faces, and there is no visible contact shadow or defocus. The pale tread tops still read as lids as deep as half a riser, so the zero tier looks raised. The plate is a plain grey gradient rather than 01's granite. 05's gauge blocks still render as steel-blue bar-chart slabs with a thin grey cap, despite the 0xA7ADB4 change, and the upper right is an empty dark field. 09 is still 02's flat 2D blue band at a closer crop, more than half the frame flat lacquer. Its new 'cut neighbour' is an unexplained grey gradient rectangle cropped at the left edge, and below the chamfer is near-black. 08's rod is still a flat white bar over a hard dark band, with a dead felt region between the tag groups. 01 is a clean PBR render but materially plain (flat blue faces, plain granite). No frame delivers masterful real depth.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: The art encodes the record exactly. On 01 the slide is three graduations back with 2030 over 2027 (C09). On 03 the needle sits at 75 against a witness at 50. On 04 the tread edges sit at 6/8/10 on a linear axis (I measured 631, 800 and 969 display px against 0 at 125), with equal risers of about 124 px. On 05 I checked the lines on a 14.5 px-per-point scale: the gold line at 20/1.5 (y 1510), 15.3 at 1481, 10 at 1558, and the blocks at 57, 60.4, 24.7 and 23. 07 holds 332 slots and 218 cards. 08 hangs Milestone 2 at October 2025 with the FY26 and FY27 brackets running October to September. 'Not published' is consistently an absence. Blemishes: 04's zero-tier top face reads as a raised step at thumb size; 08's 2028 tag body starts about Sept 2027, under the end of the FY2027 bracket, though its strings are right of it. The metrology metaphor is generic: a stranger would guess 'a statute measuring error rates', not Alaska or SNAP.

criteria.notes: Named Alaska institutions and numbers run throughout: Legislative Finance, the Department of Health, EIS/ARIES, ADN, Alaska's four rates, 218 of 332 technicians, $6.6M against nearly $11M, and the state's own 'COBOL on a mainframe'. 02 to 04 are national statute mechanics that fit any state. No Alaska place, person or geography appears on any slide beyond the Juneau coordinates fixture.

editor_notes_for_email: Score 8.14 against the round-3 threshold of 8.0 with zero hard fails, so it SHIPS. Artwork craft is 6.5, under the 8.5 craft floor. The run's one craft-floor cycle was spent in round 3 (frames 04, 09, 02, 08, 05). It improved 02's steel pockets and 08's manila but did not lift the art score: 04 (the planned depth frame), 05 and 09 remain chart-like or flat. Record that honestly in the ledger and the email. Before posting, the human should know: (1) This deck has NO AI angle; the only AI lead (Nava's tool) had no fetched Alaska link and was killed. Decide whether that fits the Alaska.Ai feed. (2) 'Opened Thursday' is in the title and on 01 and 03, so post Friday, October 2nd; from October 6th 'Thursday' points at the previous week. (3) The 2025 rate of 23 percent and 'nation's highest' rest on ADN and AP only (USDA returned 403), so open both links first. (4) $6.6 million (Legislative Finance) and nearly $11 million (ADN) are deliberately left unreconciled and attributed. (5) Slide 07's backlog quote is credited to 'the Department of Health'; the writer is spokesperson Mirna Estrada, named in the first comment. (6) The 2029/2030 pairing is labelled on 02 and in the comment as arithmetic on the statute, not an agency statement. (7) Pipeline: site_fresh FAIL must be cleared by the Phase 11 rebuild before the merge, and the Gmail image/PDF URLs resolve only after the merge to main.
